elements.name: Sol yazı
elements.text:
Two hearts that met
at the loveliest stop
of a long journey
now share the lead
in the same story...
The lovebirds are
officially big news!

elements.name: Sağ yazı
elements.text:
Not just today,
but every day...
With the same thrill,
the same love,
on the same road...
Because for us,
love isn't one day—
it's a lifelong choice.

elements.name: Haber yazısı 2
elements.text:
How did we meet?
See page 2...

elements.name: Haber yazısı 3
elements.text:
Date, venue and
all the details
on page 4...

elements.name: Slogan
elements.text: Happy pages of the same story, always

elements.name: Hikaye
elements.text:
At first glance it all might have looked like coincidence, but in time we realized it was the most beautiful plan life had written for us. We came from different worlds and met at the same point. Our laughter, our dreams and, above all, how good we are for each other...
And now, we're ready to carry this beautiful story into forever.

elements.name: Çizelge notu 1
elements.text:
It all began
with a glance...

elements.name: Çizelge notu 2
elements.text:
The first of many
long talks...

elements.name: Giriş yazısı
elements.text: This page is dedicated to our most beautiful memories so far, to the dear friends by our side, and to the people who make our lives even more special.

elements.name: Dost sözü 1
elements.text: “Seeing you together reminded me that love is still possible.”

elements.name: Dost sözü 2
elements.text: “So lucky to have you, and so lucky you have each other. What a couple!”

elements.name: Dost sözü 3
elements.text: “You're life's sweetest coincidence. To many happy years!”

elements.name: Alt slogan
elements.text: Beautiful memories always herald brighter tomorrows.

elements.name: Slogan
elements.text: Not just a goodbye, but a toast to brighter beginnings...

elements.name: Teşekkür yazısı
elements.text: Thank you endlessly for being with us on the most special day of our lives and for sharing this happiness with us.

elements.name: İkinci paragraf
elements.text: Your presence made this day even more meaningful and unforgettable for us. We're so lucky to have you...

elements.name: Alt yazı 1
elements.text:
Today a wedding,
tomorrow a lifetime...

elements.name: Alt yazı 2
elements.text:
The same story,
happily ever after...

elements.name: Alt yazı 3
elements.text:
For being with us
on this beautiful day...
we're so lucky to have you...
